nodes.title:
Better outcomes
through data & AI
nodes.desc: Condensed outcome-first presentation model. Five outcomes and fifteen deliverables. Groupings are presentation choices, not new approved scope. Detailed source IDs are mapped in deliverable descriptions and the companion mapping file.

nodes.title: Better member service
nodes.desc: Outcome grouping for navigation. Does not imply completion or a separate funded project.

nodes.title: Trusted staff answers
nodes.desc:
Governed knowledge, retrieval quality, permissions and SME acceptance. Current knowledge-agent delivery does not require the entire CDP or Foundry.
Detailed register IDs: ai-knowledge-agent, ai-knowledge-export, ai-knowledge-tests, ai-knowledge-sme-exit.
Current aggregate status not established; no completion percentage inferred.

nodes.title: Better call summaries

Improve summary quality and staff-reviewed wrap-up. Separate from knowledge-agent release.

Current aggregate status not established; no completion percentage inferred.

nodes.title: Connected voice assistance
nodes.desc:

Current aggregate status not established; no completion percentage inferred.

nodes.title: More capable employees
nodes.desc: Outcome grouping for navigation. Does not imply completion or a separate funded project.

nodes.title: Trusted data products

Controlled testing needs a governed production data product with access, quality and support evidence. Scale only with outcome, control and cost evidence.
Detailed register IDs: ai-data-agents, ai-data-test, ai-evidence-scale.

nodes.title: Smarter lending and growth
nodes.desc: Outcome grouping for navigation. Does not imply completion or a separate funded project.

nodes.desc:

Detailed register IDs: ai-platform, ai-m365-services, ai-foundry-ready, ai-governance, ai-apra, ai-controls.

nodes.desc:
